ENTITY_ID='PA3156031'  AND ENTITY_TYPE='ACCNT' (UPDATED) .
ENTITY_ID='PA1552475'  AND ENTITY_TYPE='ACCNT' (DELETED) . 
ENTITY_ID='PA1554486'  AND ENTITY_TYPE='ACCNT' (UNCHANGED) .
ENTITY_ID='9999'  AND ENTITY_TYPE='ACCNT' (NEW RECORD) . 

select ENTITY_ID ENTITY_ID2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT ENTITY_ID ENTITY_ID2,ENTITY_TYPE ENTITY_TYPE2, INT_FREQ_MONTHS_DR INT_FREQ_MONTHS_DR2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_ENTITYINTEREST WHERE ENTITY_ID='PA3156031' AND ENTITY_TYPE='ACCNT'
UNION ALL
SELECT ENTITY_ID ENTITY_ID2,ENTITY_TYPE ENTITY_TYPE2, INT_FREQ_MONTHS_DR INT_FREQ_MONTHS_DR2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_ENTITYINTEREST WHERE ENTITY_ID='PA1552475' AND ENTITY_TYPE='ACCNT'
UNION ALL
SELECT ENTITY_ID ENTITY_ID2,ENTITY_TYPE ENTITY_TYPE2, INT_FREQ_MONTHS_DR INT_FREQ_MONTHS_DR2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_ENTITYINTEREST WHERE ENTITY_ID='PA1554486' AND ENTITY_TYPE='ACCNT'
UNION ALL
SELECT ENTITY_ID ENTITY_ID2,ENTITY_TYPE ENTITY_TYPE2, INT_FREQ_MONTHS_DR INT_FREQ_MONTHS_DR2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_ENTITYINTEREST WHERE ENTITY_ID='9999'  AND ENTITY_TYPE='ACCNT' ) temp order by ENTITY_ID, SCD_START_DATE
